sn51.13:1.2: The basic statement includes a long compound (_chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ_), which leaves the relationship between the terms ambiguous. This analysis clarifies that the first two terms have a dependent relationship, “immersion due to enthusiasm”.
sn51.13:1.7: This confirms that these two items of the compound belong together. Both _padhāna_ is a normal term for “effort, striving”, while _saṅkhāra_ can mean “effective work” ([sn48.17:1.5]()). The explanation shows that the energy here is not just something that one has, but which is generated through the active exercise of the four duties
